calculation_handling.description: Minimum 1.5 m soft landscaping strip along each side and rear lot line of a lot with a place of worship.
At least 75 percent of the required front yard landscaping must be soft landscaping; the front yard not used for vehicle access must be landscaping.
Where the lot abuts a lot in the Residential or Residential Apartment Zone category, a 3.0 m soft landscaping strip and a fence are required along the abutting lot line.
calculation_handling.gaps: zone of the abutting lot and the fence requirement are not evaluated

calculation_handling.description: A driveway crossing a required landscaping area on a lot with a place of worship may be at most 6.0 m wide.

150.50.50.10(1).explanation: A lot with a place of worship needs a 1.5 m soft landscaping strip along each side and rear lot line, landscaping in the front yard outside vehicle access with at least 75 percent of it soft, and a 3.0 m soft landscaping strip plus a fence where the lot abuts residential or residential apartment land.

150.50.50.10(2).explanation: A lot with a place of worship may have a driveway crossing a required landscaping area if the driveway is no more than 6.0 m wide.
